tmp102.busTopology: single master, no concurrent configuration writer
tmp102.output: raw wire word and exact four-decimal Celsius conversion; error code if no accepted word

startupContract.required: ROM-initialized UART clock, baud and pin route; loader-established memory state
startupContract.watchdogPolicy: inherits ROM/loader state; application does not disable or service watchdogs
startupContract.mainReturn: entry parks; the main return status is not a host process exit code

Do not use board strap pins GPIO2, GPIO8 or GPIO9 for this example bus

Scripted GPIO fixtures are tests, not observed sensor readings
